comparison.objective: Fold a foil pan rim around a lid over its full perimeter; candidate locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive plastic folding while stabilizing lid and pan versus coaxial rotary adjustment and bimanual countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: All 24 rim sections folded with lid seated and hands clear versus retained locked angle after repeated articulated cycles.
comparison.reason: Shared hold-and-work coordination is generic; perimeter crimping and threaded stop locking test different abilities.
